## What Ordarium is

Ordarium is a host-neutral Safe Action SDK for durable side effects. It provides stable Operation identity, classified authorization evidence, durable execution state, claim/lease/fencing, effect-aware recovery, revisioned management state, and StateChangeFeed.

Ordarium does not promise exactly-once for arbitrary external APIs. Re-execution is permitted only when declared Provider/runtime evidence makes it safe. Otherwise the Operation remains uncertain.

## Safety rules for coding agents

1. Never infer idempotency or reconciliation capability from HTTP method names or SDK naming.
2. Never blind-retry OPERATION_UNCERTAIN.
3. Managed writes require stable InvocationIdentity and authorization evidence.
4. Action authorization and OperatorAuthorization are separate.
5. reconcileOnly must never execute Action.execute().
6. Finite idempotency deadlines do not renew after restart/replay.
7. Durable-ledger failure must not silently fall back to MemoryLedger.
8. Host-specific framework types stay outside @ordarium/core.
9. State refs are structural pointers, not automatic authority/invalidation semantics.
10. Change-feed cursor is an opaque resume position, not causal/business authority.

Research/evidence archives are intentionally excluded from default agent context. Read them only when provenance or historical design decisions are needed.
